label: 새싹쿼카
prompt: Create ONE original adorable collectible fantasy monster character, grass element, for a children's slide editor. A round mint-green baby quokka-like creature with two floppy leaf-shaped ears, cream oval belly, three tiny peach flower buds on its forehead, short chubby paws and a curled fern tail. Large sparkling dark eyes, delighted small open smile, inviting wave. Memorable simple silhouette, Japanese creature-collecting game charm, clean polished anime cel-shaded illustration with soft painterly highlights and crisp dark teal outlines. Original design, not an existing franchise character. Full body including tail and ears, centered, subject uses only middle 75% of square canvas with wide transparent padding on ALL sides. True transparent background PNG. No ground, cast shadow, scenery, text, name label, logo, watermark, border or sticker outline. Single character only.
inspection: 2026-11-12 연결 전 검사: RGBA, 네 모서리 투명, 가장자리 2px 안에 그림 없음(알파 16 초과 기준). 검은 배경에서 직접 관찰, 잘림·뿌연 테두리 없음.
